grid.title: Parceiro
grid.expression: SELECT codtipoper, desctop, nunota, dtneg, codparc, razaosocial, nutab, destabprc, cidadeuf, SUM(totalm3) AS totalm3, SUM(vlritem) AS vlrnota, SUM(vlrfrete) AS vlrfrete FROM (SELECT cab.nunota, cab.codtipoper, (SELECT DISTINCT top.descroper FROM tgftop top WHERE top.codtipoper = cab.codtipoper AND top.dhalter = cab.dhtipoper) desctop, cab.dtneg, cab.codparc, ite.nutab, (SELECT DISTINCT nta.nometab FROM tgftab tab INNER JOIN tgfnta nta ON tab.codtab = nta.codtab WHERE tab.nutab = ite.nutab) AS destabprc, par.razaosocial, cid.nomecid || '-' || uf.uf AS cidadeuf, cab.vlrnota, pro.codprod, pro.descrprod, (pro.m3 * (ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida)) AS totalm3, (ite.ad_vlrliq / ite.qtdneg) * (ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) AS vlritem, ((ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) * ite.ad_vlrunitfrete) AS vlrfrete FROM tgfcab cab INNER JOIN tgfite ite ON cab.nunota = ite.nunota INNER JOIN tgfpro pro ON ite.codprod = pro.codprod INNER JOIN tgfpar par ON (cab.codparc = par.codparc) INNER JOIN tsicid cid ON (par.codcid = cid.codcid) INNER JOIN tsiufs uf ON (cid.uf = uf.coduf) LEFT JOIN tgford ord ON cab.ordemcarga = ord.ordemcarga WHERE cab.tipmov = 'P' AND cab.pendente = 'S' AND cab.ordemcarga IN :P_OC AND nvl(ord.ad_formconc, 'N') IN :SIT) GROUP BY codtipoper, desctop, nunota, dtneg, codparc, razaosocial, nutab, destabprc, cidadeuf ORDER BY nunota, dtneg

grid.title: Por Pedido
grid.expression: SELECT cab.nunota, ite.codprod, pro.descrprod, (pro.m3 * (ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida)) AS m3, (ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) AS qtdneg, ((ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) * (ite.ad_vlrliq / ite.qtdneg)) AS vlrtot, ((ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) * ite.ad_vlrunitfrete) as vlrfrete FROM tgfcab cab INNER JOIN tgfite ite ON (cab.nunota = ite.nunota) INNER JOIN tgfpro pro ON (ite.codprod = pro.codprod) WHERE cab.tipmov = 'P' AND cab.pendente = 'S' AND ite.pendente = 'S' AND cab.nunota = :A_NUNOTA ORDER BY ite.codprod

grid.title: Por Item
grid.expression: SELECT cab.codparc, par.razaosocial, cid.nomecid, uf.uf, cab.dtneg, cab.nunota, ite.codprod, pro.descrprod, (ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) AS pendente, ((ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) * pro.m3) as m3, ((ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) * (ite.ad_vlrliq / ite.qtdneg)) AS valor, ((ite.qtdneg - ite.qtdentregue - ite.qtdconferida) * ite.ad_vlrunitfrete) AS frete FROM tgfcab cab INNER JOIN tgfpar par ON cab.codparc = par.codparc INNER JOIN tgfite ite ON cab.nunota = ite.nunota INNER JOIN tgfpro pro ON ite.codprod = pro.codprod INNER JOIN tsicid cid ON par.codcid = cid.codcid INNER JOIN tsiufs uf ON cid.uf = uf.coduf LEFT JOIN tgford ord ON cab.ordemcarga = ord.ordemcarga WHERE cab.tipmov = 'P' AND ite.pendente = 'S' AND cab.ordemcarga IN :P_OC AND ite.codprod IN :A_CODPROD AND NVL(ord.ad_formconc, 'N') IN :SIT ORDER BY cab.nunota
